Overview

Manila is a city in Metro Manila with a population of 1,846,000. The Philippines’ historic capital and cultural heart, a bustling metropolis where centuries-old churches meet modern skyscrapers. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
